shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git log -3 --oneline
sed -n '1,100p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,120p' CHANGELOG.md
sed -n '1,220p' package.json
sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n \"validated by|specs/.*#|onError|new Date\" specs src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | head -120"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git show --stat --oneline HEAD~1
git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md
sed -n '1,120p' .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n \"non-Error|instance|onError\" specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md
git status --short'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "Fix CI findings for onError change" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
